notes.title: 2025-07-10 Updates
notes.content:
Added 3 new weapon augments to arc attack
[list]
[*] Multiple Projectiles
[*] Target Highest Health
[*] Crit if at max range of attack
[/list]
should get an augment every 7th level currently

notes.title: 2025-07-09 changes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] global crit/crit damage
[*] increased enemy health
[*] reduced enemy item drop rate
[*] abilities purchasable in shop
[*] ability override menu
[*] duration changed to flat from percentage scaling
[*] mines removed on level reset
[*] upgrades don't show duplicate of same type anymore
[*] reduced max scale of void cutters
[/list]

More Talents added,
shops can be closed with r key on keyboard
rotation of bosses slowed down
incremental health scaling of enemies increased from 7 to 10 seconds
few items in shop had prices adjusted
players starting currency set to 2k from 10k now that items have been tested more
